title: Rav Chaninah bar Minyumi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was a student of Abaye, as in Bava Batra 131a, and Menachot 70b, where he raised a difficulty to Abaye; and in Zevachim 83b: 'Rabbi Chananya bar Menyumi taught in the school of Rabbi Eliezer ben Jacob', and so it is in Menachot 26b; and in Yoma 45b the reading is 'Rabbi Chananya bar Menyuma'.

notes.text: The supplied heading has Chaninah, while the reporting passages have Chananyah; Minyumi and Minyuma also differ. The forms are retained rather than silently harmonized.
The consulted Menachot 26b text names Rav Chanina bar Minyomei. Hyman’s Chananya and Minyuma forms follow the readings he cites.
